end.summary:
Practised rounding large numbers to the nearest thousand, lakh, and crore.
Used the digit immediately to the right of the chosen place to decide rounding.
Judged the size of rounding errors in all 3 attempts correctly.
A chain-rounding mix-up appeared once and was not corrected after it was last seen.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised exact versus approximate values, including when exact amounts matter and how to round directly to a chosen place. Ayaan correctly judged the size of rounding errors and used the next digit correctly in several examples. They mixed up direct rounding with rounding in a chain once; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, practise 3 examples by circling the target place, checking only the next digit, and then explaining whether the result is an exact or approximate value.
